caption:
Half your rent is already gone.

The 50% rule: about half of rent goes to operating costs (taxes, insurance, repairs/CapEx, vacancy, management), before the mortgage.

$2,000 rent → ~$1,000 left for the mortgage.
A $300K house (25% down, 7%, 30 yr) = $1,497/mo → −$497/mo.
Max price that works ≈ $200K.

It's a quick, conservative screen. Real costs vary by property, so run the real numbers before you offer.
